# C23 public header API audit

**Baseline:** WG14 N3220, the public working draft prepared after the final C23 DIS ballot comments, checked by clause and header synopsis against the public headers in `include/`. The N3221 editor's report states that accepted DIS-comment changes were integrated into N3220 and that no technical changes were made after N3219; N3220 differs from N3219 only by an editorial Annex K footnote. This is an inventory of the declared source API and header macros; it does not establish that each declared function is implemented correctly or linkable. The project target is Windows x86-64 with Clang, two's-complement integers, UTF-8 narrow multibyte encoding, 32-bit `wchar_t`, and no decimal floating types. Required standard headers are project-owned and do not depend on Clang resource headers.

N3220 is the baseline throughout; clause numbers below are the normative cross-reference. It is available at <https://www.open-std.org/jtc1/sc22/wg14/www/docs/n3220.pdf>; the editor's report is <https://open-std.org/jtc1/sc22/wg14/www/docs/n3221.htm>. The optional IEC 60559 Annex F / interchange Annex H and optional Annex K bounds-checking interfaces are not silently counted as core. Decimal interfaces are unsupported by the documented compiler target. A header's absence from the implementation is a gap only where it is listed below as unconditional; implementation-defined extensions are not treated as required names.

## Header checklist

| Header | Required surface inventoried (N3220 clause) | Current header status |
|---|---|---|
| `<assert.h>` | `assert(...)`, `NDEBUG` behavior and `__STDC_VERSION_ASSERT_H__`; C23 variadic assertion expression support (7.2). | Present. Header is intentionally re-includable so changes to `NDEBUG` take effect. |
| `<complex.h>` | `complex`, `I`, `CMPLX/F/L`; complex arithmetic, projection, trigonometric, hyperbolic, exponential, logarithmic, power, square-root and magnitude functions in double/float/long-double forms (7.3). | Core declarations/macros present. Decimal floating overloads are unavailable on target. |
| `<ctype.h>` | `isalnum`, `isalpha`, `isblank`, `iscntrl`, `isdigit`, `isgraph`, `islower`, `isprint`, `ispunct`, `isspace`, `isupper`, `isxdigit`, `tolower`, `toupper` (7.4). | Present. |
| `<errno.h>` | `errno`, `EDOM`, `EILSEQ`, `ERANGE` (7.5). Other POSIX-style errno values in the header are implementation extensions. | Required names present. |
| `<fenv.h>` | `fenv_t`, `fexcept_t`, exception/rounding macros, environment and exception APIs, plus C23 `femode_t`, `FE_DFL_MODE`, `fegetmode`, `fesetmode`, `fesetexcept`, `fetestexceptflag` (7.6). | Implemented for the supported Windows x86-64 target. `FE_TONEARESTFROMZERO` is conditionally defined only when get/set rounding support exists for ties-away; this target does not provide it. Verify IEC feature claims against supported operations before advertising Annex F. |
| `<float.h>` | Radix, precision, range and evaluation macros for standard real types; C23 normalized maxima, signaling NaN and IEC feature macros as applicable (5.2.4.2.2, 7.7). | Project-owned definitions use compiler predefined macros and builtins. Per-type `*_IS_IEC_60559` values are 1 for this target: float is binary32 and double/long double are binary64. N3220 5.2.4.2.2 specifies these macros report matching precision and exponent range; they do not imply Annex F conformance. `tests/fundamental_headers.c` checks target facts. |
| `<inttypes.h>` | `__STDC_VERSION_INTTYPES_H__`, `imaxdiv_t`, `imaxabs`, `imaxdiv`, `strtoimax`, `strtoumax`, wide conversion counterparts; all `PRI*`/`SCN*` families for exact, least, fast, max and pointer-width types, including C23 binary conversions (7.8). | Header and generator provide the version macro, families, and functions. Format length modifiers are target-derived. |
| `<iso646.h>` | Eleven macros `and`, `and_eq`, `bitand`, `bitor`, `compl`, `not`, `not_eq`, `or`, `or_eq`, `xor`, `xor_eq` (7.9). | **Added in this audit** as `include/iso646.h`; absent before. |
| `<limits.h>` | Standard integer limits and C23 `*_WIDTH`, `BOOL_MAX`, `BOOL_WIDTH`, `BITINT_MAXWIDTH` macros (5.2.4.2.1, 7.10). | Project-owned definitions use compiler predefined macros; `MB_LEN_MAX` is 4 for the documented UTF-8 implementation. |
| `<locale.h>` | `struct lconv`, `LC_*` categories, `setlocale`, `localeconv` (7.11). | Present. |
| `<math.h>` | Standard real math functions in `double`/`float`/`long double` forms, classification/comparison macros, C23 `float_t`/`double_t`, `FP_*` macros, min/max and rounding additions, narrowing arithmetic, `fromfp*`, canonicalization and IEC-conditional total-order/payload APIs (7.12). | Core public groups are declared. Annex F totalorder/payload names are behind `__STDC_WANT_IEC_60559_EXT__` and the IEC feature test macro; decimal overloads are unavailable. Function declarations alone do not establish implementation coverage. |
| `<setjmp.h>` | `jmp_buf`, `setjmp` and `longjmp` (7.13). | Present. |
| `<signal.h>` | `sig_atomic_t`, required `SIG*` macros, `signal`, `raise` (7.14). | Present. |
| `<stdalign.h>` | No content is required in C23 (7.15). | Correctly empty apart from guard/comment. |
| `<stdarg.h>` | `va_list`, `va_start`, `va_arg`, `va_end`, `va_copy`, version macro (7.16). | Project-owned header uses compiler va-list types and vararg builtins; no resource-header include is required. |
| `<stdatomic.h>` | Atomic type aliases, `memory_order`, `ATOMIC_*_LOCK_FREE`, initialization/flag macros, generic atomic operations and fences (7.17). | Project-owned types/macros use compiler atomic builtins; callable runtime operations are implemented in libc23. |
| `<stdbit.h>` | Endianness macros, five typed external families (`uc/us/ui/ul/ull`) and type-generic `stdc_*` operations (7.18). | Present; generic macros use compiler C23 builtins for extended and bit-precise unsigned types as well as standard unsigned types. |
| `<stdbool.h>` | In C23, `bool`, `true`, and `false` are language keywords; header retains `__bool_true_false_are_defined` for compatibility (7.19). | Correctly defines only the compatibility macro in C mode; no obsolete header version macro. |
| `<stdckdint.h>` | `ckd_add`, `ckd_sub`, `ckd_mul` (7.20). | Present using compiler overflow builtins. |
| `<stddef.h>` | `ptrdiff_t`, `size_t`, `max_align_t`, `wchar_t`, C23 `nullptr_t`, `NULL`, `offsetof`, `unreachable`; `rsize_t` only when Annex K is supported (7.21). | Project-owned definitions use compiler predefined types and builtins; `max_align_t` has 16-byte alignment for the Windows x64 scalar ABI. `__need_*` partial inclusion is covered by header fixtures. |
| `<stdint.h>` | Exact-width types/macros where supported; least/fast, pointer, max-width types; C23 width macros; integer constant macros; `WCHAR_*` and `WINT_*` ranges/widths (7.22). | Project-owned definitions use compiler predefined integer types and limits. `wint_t` is 32-bit unsigned in this 32-bit-`wchar_t` target, not Clang's 16-bit Windows predefined `__WINT_TYPE__`. |
| `<stdio.h>` | File types/macros including `_PRINTF_NAN_LEN_MAX` and all formatted I/O, character/string/binary I/O, positioning/status, and file-management APIs (7.23). | `_PRINTF_NAN_LEN_MAX` is 4 for the implementation's `[-]NAN` output style; compile and formatting fixtures check the required bound. |
| `<stdlib.h>` | Numeric conversions including `strfrom*`; allocation including `free_sized`/`free_aligned_sized`; process/environment, search/sort, integer arithmetic, multibyte conversion, and `memalignment` (7.24). | `memalignment(const void *)` and the `bsearch` qualifier-preserving generic macro are declared. `memalignment` is a C23 requirement in N3220 7.24.9.1. |
| `<stdnoreturn.h>` | `noreturn` expands to `_Noreturn` for compatibility (7.25). | Present for C; no nonstandard version macro is added. |
| `<string.h>` | Byte/string functions, C23 `memccpy`, `strdup`, `strndup`, `memset_explicit`, and qualifier-preserving generic returns for search functions (7.26). | Surface present, including const-preserving macros. |
| `<tgmath.h>` | Type-generic macros corresponding to real/complex math functions where required (7.27). | Present. Decimal type-generic selection is unsupported with the target's documented lack of decimal types. |
| `<threads.h>` | Thread, mutex, condition, once, and thread-specific-storage APIs/types/status values (7.28). | Present. This implementation supplies thread support; it is not relying on the standard's allowance for implementations that do not support threads. |
| `<time.h>` | `clock_t`, `time_t`, `struct tm`, clock/time conversions and formatting, `timespec_get`, C23 `timespec_getres` (7.29). | Present. `timegm`, `gmtime_r`, and `localtime_r` are required C23 functions (7.29.2.4 and 7.29.3.3). |
| `<uchar.h>` | `char8_t`, `char16_t`, `char32_t`, UTF feature macros, restartable UTF conversion functions (7.30). | Types/macros and conversion surface present. |
| `<wchar.h>` | Version macro `__STDC_VERSION_WCHAR_H__`, wide formatted I/O, file I/O, conversions, string/memory operations, locale conversion, time formatting and wide numeric conversions (7.31). | Present; project adds qualifier-preserving macros for search functions. |
| `<wctype.h>` | `wint_t`, `wctype_t`, `wctrans_t`, wide classification, case mapping and descriptor APIs (7.32). | Present. |

## Conditional surface and implementation claims

- **Annex K:** Bounds-checking interfaces (`rsize_t`, `_s` functions and related constraints) are conditional. They are not counted as missing while the implementation does not advertise Annex K support.
- **IEC 60559:** IEC-specific operation groups and feature macros must be gated by the matching feature-test macros and actual implementation guarantees. The target must not claim IEC conformance simply because Clang supplies a macro or builtin.
- **Decimal floating point:** Decimal types and `*d32/*d64/*d128` function families are absent by documented design and compiler limitation. Do not report these as missing for this target while it leaves `__STDC_IEC_60559_DFP__` undefined.
- **Compiler primitives:** the six headers `stdint.h`, `stddef.h`, `stdarg.h`, `stdatomic.h`, `float.h`, and `limits.h` are project-owned and use compiler predefined macros, types, and builtins directly. They do not include Clang resource headers or host system headers.
- **Header version macros:** `__STDC_VERSION_<HEADER>_H__` should be defined only for headers for which C23 requires one. In particular, `stdbool.h` and `stdalign.h` do not gain such a macro merely because their legacy headers exist.

## Header verification boundary

1. The per-type IEC format values are checked for the supported Windows x86-64 target by `tests/fundamental_headers.c`; they are not an Annex F conformance claim.
2. The six project-owned compiler-interface headers passed strict `-nostdinc` checks without a resource include directory. The `max_align_t` scalar `__int128` alignment fix was checked in rebuilt release/debug tests; see [STATUS.md](STATUS.md).

A machine-checkable companion, `tests/compile_only/c23_required_surface.c`, independently names the required function families, types, and macros from N3220; it takes addresses of APIs and expands required macro families without executing them. Nine compile fixtures passed Clang C23 syntax-only compilation for Windows x86-64 under strict `-nostdinc`, with no resource include directory. The full project-only release/debug verification passed 31 standalone headers, 45 resolved project-header includes, and the 715/730 API audit with zero missing definitions or conflicts. The declaration checklist is finite and clause-based. Passing this header audit does not certify runtime behavior, symbol definitions, floating-point conformance, or ABI details.
